fixes.title: Fix local + category signals in Bio name and captions (Burlington + garage doors/operator/gates)
fixes.whyItMatters: Right now local visibility is weak (score 37) even though Burlington is mentioned in checks; making the city + category explicit in the most visible fields improves discovery for “garage door” searches around Burlington, Ontario.
fixes.exactAction: Update the Instagram display name to: "Activedoor Garage Doors | Burlington, ON" and update the first line of your bio to: "Commercial & Residential Garage Doors, Operators & Gates in Burlington, Ontario". Then, for the next 5 posts, add a caption first line like: "Burlington, Ontario — Garage door repair/installation" and tag geolocation "Burlington, Ontario" on each.
fixes.evidence: Local visibility score is 37 and the only location signal noted is terms checked: burlington, ontario; competitor gap is high (93), so discovery must be tightened.

fixes.title: Strengthen sales readiness with one clear “service next step” on every post (consistent CTA + link path)
fixes.whyItMatters: Sales readiness is very low (29/100). Visitors may engage but not know what to do next; one consistent, explicit next step plus a clear link-in-bio path increases conversions.
fixes.exactAction: Add this CTA to the last line of every new caption for 2 weeks: "For help in Burlington, call (905) 689-5308 or visit activedoor.ca." Also pin one comment on each of your top 3 posts with the same message and include the website in your link-in-bio landing section titled "Garage Door Service in Burlington" (ensure users land on the relevant service page from that section).
fixes.evidence: Sales readiness score is 29 (6/50) indicating low readiness, while profile conversion is strong (70), meaning visitors are showing interest but likely not converting.

fixes.title: Turn your current content into save/share magnets using a repeatable hook + takeaway format
fixes.whyItMatters: Content performance is lagging (score 40) and you only have about 3 posts in the last 30 days; with garage doors, “what to do/check” posts earn saves, which is where local reach comes from.
fixes.exactAction: Create 3 carousel/Reels using this exact structure: Slide 1 (hook): "Garage door not working in Burlington? Check this first." Slide 2: "Quick safety check: disconnect power before troubleshooting." Slide 3: "Common cause: sensor alignment (what it looks like)." Slide 4: "If it’s the motor/rollers: what signs to watch for." Slide 5 (takeaway): "Save this checklist and call Activedoor when you’re ready." Caption first line: "Burlington, Ontario — Garage door troubleshooting checklist". Finish caption with: "Call (905) 689-5308".
fixes.evidence: Content performance score is 40 and recent posting is low (~0.70/wk) which makes each post need higher save/share value; competitor gap is large (93), so differentiated format matters.

fixes.title: Differentiate with a signature “Burlington Garage Door Fix Guide” series (competitor-proof format)
fixes.whyItMatters: Competitor gap is already strong (93), but that also means you’re competing in a crowded category. A unique series name and consistent format gives people a reason to follow and returns improve reach over time.
fixes.exactAction: Launch a named series in captions and covers: "Burlington Garage Door Fix Guide #1–#5". For each episode, use the same layout: (1) Problem photo/video, (2) 3 likely causes, (3) 1 do/don’t safety tip, (4) when to call (include phone), (5) one cost-factor note (no pricing—just factors like rollers/sensors/motor type). Use consistent cover text colors and keep episode length to 20–35 seconds for Reels.
fixes.evidence: Competitor gap score is 93 and notes a client posting cadence advantage (client=0.70/wk vs ref=0.31/wk). The missing piece is signature differentiation rather than generic informational posts.

fixes.title: Upgrade pinned posts to reduce decision time (make them match the top visitor intent)
fixes.whyItMatters: Profile conversion is solid (70) but you can make the follow decision faster by pinning posts that answer the most common intents immediately: repair help, installation, and gates/operators.
fixes.exactAction: Update your 3 pinned slots to: (1) "Residential Garage Door Service in Burlington" (before/after or problem/solution), (2) "Commercial Garage Door Operators & Gates" (work examples), (3) "Garage Door Troubleshooting Checklist" (save-worthy carousel). In each pinned post caption, include the first line with service + location, and end with: "Call (905) 689-5308 or visit activedoor.ca." Then set a highlight titled "Service Areas" linking to a Burlington-focused page on your website.
fixes.evidence: Profile conversion score is 70 and content frequency is low; pinned posts are a high-leverage fix because they shape the visitor’s first 5–10 seconds without requiring more posting.
